neighbours.label: the verb take/took/taking or walk introducing an action (take a walk, take the turn, took a long walk)
fire: After lunch the two of them decided to take a short walk along the canal.
Before the exam she took a deep breath and opened the booklet.
When you reach the old mill, take the second left towards the farm.
On Sundays my grandfather walked to the harbour to watch the boats.
The signal is taking longer than usual to reach the satellite tonight.
Each team may take one time-out during the second half.
We walked the length of the beach while the sun went down.
Please take your shoes off before you come into the kitchen.
quiet: After lunch the two of them decided to have a short chat about the canal.
Before the exam she read the instructions twice and opened the booklet.
When you reach the old mill, the farm is the second building on the left.
On Sundays my grandfather sat at the harbour to watch the boats.
The signal seems weaker than usual at the satellite station tonight.
Each team gets one time-out during the second half.
We sat on the beach and watched while the sun went down.
Please leave your umbrella by the door before you come into the kitchen.

notes: Card top 32: ' take' x11, ' walk' x6, ' took' x3, ' walked' x3, ' taking' x2. Near misses keep the scenes with other verbs (have, make, go, run).
